title: Create gf2-algebra crate skeleton + workspace member
description:
Create the new `gf2-algebra` crate with the directory layout, MSRV pin, and workspace registration that downstream W1-W7 issues consume.

## Background

The epic introduces a new top-level workspace crate `gf2-algebra` that hosts the `PackedField<F>` trait, packed bipedal types, and permanent algorithms. The crate boundary and dependency-direction graph were settled by D1a; the trait surface was settled by D1b; this issue creates the actual crate skeleton that those decisions describe.

The skeleton must compile clean as an empty crate so the rest of W1 (T2-T6) can land code into it without redoing wiring. Per `dev/plans/d1a_gf2_algebra_boundary.md`, the crate depends on `gf2-core` (mandatory) and feature-gates `gf2-kernels-simd` (default-on `simd`) and `gf2-kernels-hip` (default-off `hip`).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-algebra/Cargo.toml` exists, registers MSRV 1.95, declares dependency on `gf2-core`, and feature-gates `simd` (default on) and `hip` (default off) per the D1c feature-gate matrix.
- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-algebra/` is registered as a workspace member in the root `Cargo.toml`.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo build -p gf2-algebra --release --all-features` succeeds.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` succeeds (zero tests is acceptable at this stage).
- [ ] [hard] The crate carries `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` at the lib root, matching the project's unsafe-isolation invariant.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
